title: SupplementaryFindings
description: Findings extracted from an atlas (or subatlas) paper's supplementary material by the scan-supplements subagent, written to supplementary_findings.json. Every finding carries an explicit source_paper (the parent paper is no longer assumed to be the atlas) and retrieval_method (see issue #12).

markers.description: Marker genes for the cell type with provenance.

other_findings.description: Non-marker findings (function, spatial, trajectory, etc.) with provenance.

evidence_quotes.description: Exact-substring quotes from the supplementary material with provenance.

role.description: What the source paper IS relative to the corpus. For supplement findings this MUST be 'atlas' or 'subatlas' — a supplement always belongs to a corpus member (enforced by report_checker).

retrieval_method.description: The MECHANISM by which this finding was obtained. Supplement findings are 'supplement'.

SourcePaper.description: The paper the supplement belongs to. At least one of doi / corpus_id must be present, and it must resolve to a corpus member in paper_catalogue.json (enforced by report_checker).

SupplementRef.description: Locator for the supplementary source (replaces the old free-text source_table/source_file).

sheet.description: Sheet/tab name within the file, if applicable.

evidence_type.description: How the marker was derived (DE analysis, known markers, immunostaining, etc.).

quote.description: Exact substring of the supplementary text.

context.description: Brief note on what the quote covers.
